newsitem.title: USA: ARCO strikes oil in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: ARCO strikes oil in Algeria.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co said on Monday it struck oil in Algeria's Ghadames Basin, about 74 miles northeast of the country's largest oil field, Hassi Messauod.

In a statement, ARCO said its Semhari-1 well, located on the Hassi Bir Rekaiz block, tested at a cumulative rate of 1,539 barrels per day from two drilling zones. It was drilled to a total depth of 13,337 feet, and will be explored further to determine if the discovery is commercial. ARCO owns a 75 percent working interest in the Hassi Bir Rekaiz block. TPAO, Turkey's national oil company, owns the other 25 percent.
